fact_text: Before leaving Ecuador for good, a person with a RUC (tax registration) should suspend or cancel it. This is done online with your access key through the SRI en Linea transactional portal, or via the virtual secretariat, once you stop your economic activity in Ecuador.
evidence_quote: Recuerde que puede inscribir su RUC accediendo con su clave al portal transaccional SRI en Línea. Realice estos trámites desde la secretaría virtual

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Even a returning US citizen who held a RUC while resident in Ecuador must proactively suspend/cancel it; it does not close automatically on departure.

fact_text: When employment in Ecuador ends, the employer must notify the IESS of the worker's separation (aviso de salida) within three (3) days of the event, which de-registers the affiliate from the Seguro General Obligatorio. Confirm your aviso de salida was filed before you leave.
evidence_quote: El empleador dará aviso al IESS de la modificación del sueldo o salario, la enfermedad, la separación del trabajador (aviso de salida), u otra novedad relevante para la historia laboral del asegurado, dentro del término de tres (3) días posteriores a la ocurrencia del hecho

fact_text: After your cessation date at work, an IESS affiliate keeps two months of coverage for illness and maternity benefits and services. Do not count on IESS health cover beyond that window once you have left Ecuador.
evidence_quote: Después de la fecha de cese en el trabajo, el afiliado (a) tiene dos meses de cobertura con prestaciones y servicios, para los casos de enfermedad y maternidad

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Residual 2-month IESS cover after cessation is often overlooked when planning the gap before re-enrolling in US health coverage.

fact_text: Your qualification for the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion under the bona fide residence test ends on the date you abandon your foreign (Ecuador) residence. When you move back to the US, you can no longer treat later income as foreign earned income under bona fide residence, so normal full US taxation resumes.
evidence_quote: you will qualify as a bona fide resident starting with the date you began the residency and ending with the date you abandon your foreign residence

applies_to.non_obvious_note: FEIE eligibility can cover part of the year of return, but ends the moment foreign residence is abandoned; the return year is typically a split-year for FEIE purposes.

fact_text: As a US citizen you are subject to the same US income tax laws whether you live abroad or in the US, so you must continue to file US returns; after returning you resume normal filing on worldwide income without the abroad-specific exclusions.
evidence_quote: If you are a U.S. citizen or a resident alien living in a foreign country, you are subject to the same U.S. income tax laws that apply to U.S. citizens and resident aliens living in the United States

fact_text: After you move to Washington you have 30 days to get a Washington driver license, and you need it before you can register any vehicles in the state. This is a key step in re-establishing Washington residency.
evidence_quote: You have 30 days after you move to Washington to get your driver license. You will also need your Washington driver license before you can register any vehicles here.

fact_text: Washington considers you a resident if, among other things, you have a Washington address, are registered to vote in Washington, receive state benefits, receive in-state tuition, or get any Washington license at resident rates. Meeting these markers is how you re-establish state residency on return.
evidence_quote: You're considered a Washington resident if you: Have a Washington address Are registered to vote in Washington. Receive state benefits. Receive in-state tuition fees.

fact_text: As a US citizen you may receive Social Security payments outside the US as long as you remain eligible, and payments continue after you return home. Returning permanently to the US removes the outside-US payment restrictions that apply to non-citizens.
evidence_quote: If you are a U.S. citizen, you may receive your Social Security payments outside the U.S. as long as you are eligible for them.

fact_text: If Social Security benefits were stopped while you were outside the US, you must return and remain lawfully present in the US for an entire calendar month to start receiving benefits again. Plan your return date so a full calendar month of presence is achievable.
evidence_quote: If we stopped your benefits, you must return and remain lawfully present for the entire calendar month to start receiving benefits again.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: The full-calendar-month presence rule to restart suspended benefits mainly bites non-citizens, but is the reactivation mechanism to be aware of when SSN-linked benefits lapsed abroad.
